title: Retire the exact Codex writer when its managed observation was sealed early
outcome: A proven completion for a current Codex command releases that command's shell move and writer custody even if the managed test observation was sealed before the process finished.
acceptance: A real native router test confirms the writer and pending one-call shell move exist before a managed observation is interrupted or refused and later settled by its exact completion.
The exact completion settles only its own shell move and writer once. The sealed observation is unchanged, no evidence or credit is added, and an older same-key writer survives.
Mismatched and unaddressed completions do not retire another execution's writer.
